claim.scope: Exact comparison composition over one deliberately small complete public-source population, supported committed inputs and explicitly selected old/replacement roles. No upstream replacement equivalence, migration-history, runtime-use, deployment-unit, global extraction-accuracy or scale claim.
claim.source_truth: Nine actual generated-method calls across four unchanged public client files; five selected endpoint sites, four outside-pair negatives. Source-only labels must be independently reviewed before indexer, extractor, candidate export or scoring.
claim.unit_truth: Three explicit evaluator-authored Go package units and one explicit unavailable mapping. Package attribution tests supplied metadata composition; it does not infer production logical services/deployments/owners.

inputs.root_mapping: Uniformly strip examples/ from original public paths; retain all original bytes, paths and hashes in origin.json. Original upstream Go module files are bound as context but not consumed.
inputs.evaluator_go_module: google.golang.org/grpc/examples; explicit dependencies in inputs/go.mod and inputs/go.sum replace upstream workspace dependency replacements. No source-body patch or stub generation.
inputs.canonicalization: Reuse spike/t472/derivation/merge with one root run; no occurrence/symbol/SCIP payload invention. Reuse fixed snapshot contracts and production decoders. Record exact tool/source hashes and raw/canonical index counts/digests.
inputs.git_boundary: Assembler does not mutate Git. Before serving, lead records distinct evaluation Git source and derived-input commits, tree, bundle digest, exact path/blob census and repository-role bindings. Neither evaluation commit is represented as the upstream commit. These bindings and independent label approval are mandatory before candidate export/scoring.

metrics.name: selected-occurrence recall
metrics.numerator: Expected exact immutable public source spans returned on the correct endpoint side with the correct declaration lineage.

metrics.name: selected-occurrence precision
metrics.denominator: Every emitted selected comparison occurrence; expected5
metrics.numerator: Returned sites exactly matching source-only labels, source tuples, side and declaration.
metrics.threshold: 5/5 and no extra or duplicate site; any unsupported extra fails

metrics.name: outside-pair exclusion
metrics.numerator: Real generated-method calls for other operations absent from selected comparison populations.

metrics.name: occurrence classification
metrics.numerator: Exact old/new membership and old_only_evidence/new_only_evidence class.
metrics.threshold: 5/5; old_only2,new_only3; both/unresolved zero real denominators reported unavailable

metrics.name: unit composition
metrics.numerator: Exact supplied unit ID or explicit unresolved occurrence, class, side counts and complete selected source membership.
metrics.threshold: 4/4; one old-only,one both,one new-only,one unresolved; no cross-unit join

metrics.name: unit attribution
metrics.numerator: Each selected call preserves its supplied candidate ID/build target or unavailable reason without inventing a deployment/service.

metrics.name: exact citation integrity
metrics.numerator: Unique immutable source sites opened via actual citation route; commit, path, Git blob, SHA256, byte/line ranges and returned selector bytes all exact.
metrics.threshold: 5/5; both levels must reference the same exact site set

metrics.name: population/accounting
metrics.numerator: All public Go files reconciled to explicit analyzed/generated/excluded/failure outcomes; four application files+support helper+four generated files accounted.
metrics.threshold: 9/9 accounted; no missing/partial/failed application or support source; no unsupported declared state hidden as zero

metrics.name: uncertainty
metrics.numerator: Source-only unlabelable generated-method sites before exclusions.
metrics.threshold: 0 unsure; any reviewer uncertainty stops before predictions

reporting: Report exact numerators/denominators, per-file results and confusion tables. For nonzero binary denominators report Wilson95 intervals beside observed rates, with no confidence-bound pass claim. Zero/absent real classes are unavailable and covered only by separately named synthetic mechanics tests. No metric may pool away a failing file/class. Repeated pagination/transport reads do not increase the independent source denominator.

read_matrix.primary: Same-repository selected old/new pair, occurrence and unit levels, page sizes1/2/100, all pages; classification and path/unit filters checked against frozen rows. HTTP and MCP output parity, authenticated UI selection/source opening; denied/anonymous reads and unsupported unrelated surfaces.
read_matrix.two_publication: Use a separately named duplicate evaluation repository only as a concurrency/authority probe; do not double quality denominators. Cross-repository unit namespaces must never join.
concurrent_publication: Acquire cursor with both current publications; publish a new exact source commit on old repository, require conflict/typed unavailable for old cursor and no mixed page.
Repeat independently for replacement repository. Use one evaluator-comment-only commit after frozen source quality scoring; preserve source selector bytes/index spans and record changed Git blob.

During each one publication transition, issue at most8 parallel first-page reads; every response must be coherent old/old or new/new authority or explicit unavailable/conflict. Old continuation must refuse.
Permissions change before final serialization and hidden-source reads remain mandatory focused regression gates; exact citations must reauthorize.
read_matrix.no_retry_rule: Single planned execution per binding. Failed product/quality/threshold checks stop; no silent resampling, source edits, label changes or repeated threshold attempts.

reused_gates: Existing exact Caller Map citation, hard-death/recovery, backup/restore and pressure/cache invalidation gates at same unchanged implementation version. Reuse only exact scoped evidence, never infer a new execution.
retained_boundaries.new_native: Ordinary startup with both actual verified comparison and caller selections using disposable key; no experimental switch. Restart/withdraw comparison while Caller Map remains, then withdraw caller dependency. Production signing key never accessed.

operating.qualification: Darwin-local small public-source input/read operating result only, not Linux capacity evidence, rehearsal, historical rerun, production SLO or scale. Actual host/source/tools/build/bindings must be recorded. Linux-targeted release/scale evidence remains unavailable.
operating.scheduling: One indexer/native workload at a time; lead assigns slot. GOMAXPROCS2, no parallel source derivations.
operating.samples: Record one cold first-page per level, five warm first-page samples per level, every page1 continuation and all five unique citations; report each value and maximum, no percentile/SLO claim. Measure sampled process-tree RSS with existing supported sampler and filesystem allocated data. If a required measurement is unavailable, report operating qualification unavailable and stop release closure.
operating.static_ceilings: Existing50,000 combined bucket positions,100 rows/page,100 hydrated records/page,4 citations/side/row,8 active exact reads,2 citation reads,8index/8binding/200,000position/128MiBidentity-per-index and five-minute cursors unchanged. Existing bound tests verify ceilings; this small source run does not demonstrate operation at those ceilings.
operating.rss_qualification: The 2 GiB bound applies to the maximum observed process-tree RSS sample. It is neither a proven transient peak nor a hard enforcement limit. Sampling cadence, successful observations and unavailable measurements are recorded. Minimum 4 GiB actually observed available physical headroom remains mandatory; swap receives no credit. A required unavailable measurement stops operating/release qualification.

stops: Independent review missing, checkpoint/input/label/source/tool hash drift or unknown required field.
Any missing dependency, parser/SCIP error, source omission, span/source mismatch, version-skewed binding or malformed input; no synthetic repair.
Any wrong/missing/extra row, side, class, unit, citation or denied-source leak.
Any partial/stale/failed/unknown state presented as exact empty success.
Any mixed authority, accepted stale cursor, hidden source opening or unsupported product activation.
Any prospective resource/time/read bound exceeded or required operating measurement unavailable.
Any surviving server, child, key, tunnel or scratch-source custody after terminal cleanup.

review.author: Codex Mac agent
review.independent_source_label_reviewer: pending exact checkpoint review by another agent; no independent-human claim
revalidation: any numerical ceiling, threshold or expected label
review.suspension: No production release before its own applicable signature. On a verified released selection, revoke comparison release ID and restart; withdraw caller dependency likewise withdraws comparison while independent products retain their own decisions.

steady_state_cost: No production code change is proposed. Qualification source download/materialization, index generation, reads and measurements are one-shot bounded work. Existing request/index/binding locks, cold-build serialization, cache invalidation, sync/startup/retry/publication/children and memory/disk ceilings remain unchanged. Final measured report must enumerate actual observed read/build/start/restart/no-op/transition work separately.
